origin.rerun: python3 scripts/ops/gates.py list --json | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(sum(1 for g in d['gates'] if g['hits_read_state']=='measured'))"

what: GATE-REGISTRY hits: every gate_registry row has hits_14d=null (hits_read_state=not_measurable) because gate refusals are logged on the VM, not in a queryable table. Mechanism shipped in #25322: comms/gates/hit_probes.json {gate_id: {table: signals, column: reason|status, equals: <value>}} turns a row measured. Next: read DISTINCT signals.status/reason on the live journal (diag relay), map values that correspond to registered gates (e.g. GATE-BAR-DEBOUNCE, GATE-MARKET-HOURS, open-package gate), commit only probes whose value is SEEN live. Population: 298 registry rows (2026-11-12 seed).
